name: Atmiv
description: This keyword will return the Implied Volatility of the ATM option for the selected underlying instrument.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword will return the  Implied Volatility  of the ATM option for the selected underlying instrument.

Pls note - ATM is selected based on futures chart and not Spot chart

![Example](./images/img-1631795373.png)

parameters.name: Underlying
parameters.description: Underlying symbol, e.g. 'NIFTY 50'. Returns the ATM option's implied volatility.

raw_scraped_text:
Atmiv
This keyword will return the 
Implied Volatility
 of the ATM option for the selected underlying instrument.
Pls note - ATM is selected based on futures chart and not Spot chart
